task.description: Produce a code design artifact at src/design/idn-01-user-registry.md for requirement IDN-01 (User registry). Define identity domain types, persistence model, and API contract for programmatic user creation with platform-assigned UUID user_id and created_at; enforce unique username (409), email format validation (422), caller-forbidden user_id input, ACTIVE/INACTIVE status handling, and integration points so INACTIVE users fail authentication with 401 when token-authenticated. Include module boundaries (identity store/service/API route/auth integration), SQL migration impact (if any), error taxonomy, and traceability from each acceptance criterion to design elements. No source code changes in this step.
acceptance_criteria: All IDN-01 acceptance criteria are mapped to explicit design elements
User model fields and invariants are fully specified (including status lifecycle)
Validation/error mapping is explicit for duplicate username (409) and invalid email (422)
Auth integration rule for INACTIVE users returning 401 is fully specified
Public API contract for create-user is documented with request/response schema
Migration or schema impact is explicitly listed with rationale

result.summary: Design artefact for IDN-01 user registry with identity model, create-user API contract, status lifecycle, auth integration, migration impact, and acceptance criteria traceability.
